n = int(input())
base = int(input())
MAXK = 31
MOD = 1000000007

digits = []
while n > 0:
    digits.append(n % base)
    n //= base
digits.reverse()
length = len(digits)

# Initialize matrices
A = [[[0 for _ in range(MAXK)] for _ in range(MAXK)] for _ in range(70)]
pre = [[0 for _ in range(MAXK)] for _ in range(MAXK)]
suf = [[0 for _ in range(MAXK)] for _ in range(MAXK)]
ans = [[0 for _ in range(MAXK)] for _ in range(MAXK)]
I = [[0 for _ in range(MAXK)] for _ in range(MAXK)]

def init_identity():
    for i in range(base + 1):
        for j in range(base + 1):
            I[i][j] = 0
        if i <= base:
            I[i][i] = 1

def multiply_matrices(A1, B, R):
    C = [[0 for _ in range(MAXK)] for _ in range(MAXK)]
    for i in range(base + 1):
        for k in range(base + 1):
            for j in range(base + 1):
                C[i][j] = (C[i][j] + A1[i][k] * B[k][j]) % MOD
    for i in range(base + 1):
        for j in range(base + 1):
            R[i][j] = C[i][j]

def prepare_matrices():
    for i in range(base):
        for j in range(base + 1):
            A[0][i][j] = 0
        A[0][i][i] = 1
        A[0][i][0] = 1
    for i in range(1, length):
        for j in range(base + 1):
            for k in range(base + 1):
                A[i][j][k] = 0
        # Copy previous matrix
        for j in range(base):
            for k in range(base + 1):
                A[i][j][k] = A[i - 1][j][k]
        # Build matrices
        for j in range(1, base):
            multiply_matrices(A[i - 1][j], pre[j - 1], pre[j])
        for j in range(base - 2, -1, -1):
            multiply_matrices(suf[j + 1], A[i - 1][j], suf[j])
        for j in range(base):
            if j > 0:
                multiply_matrices(pre[j - 1], suf[j], A[i][j])
            else:
                multiply_matrices(I, suf[j], A[i][j])

init_identity()
prepare_matrices()

answer = [[0 for _ in range(MAXK)] for _ in range(MAXK)]
for i in range(base + 1):
    answer[i][0] = 1 if i == 0 else 0

x = 0
for i in range(length - 1, -1, -1):
    for j in range(digits[i]):
        multiply_matrices(A[i][(j + x) % base], answer, answer)
    x = (x + digits[i]) % base

res = 0
for i in range(base):
    res = (res + answer[i][0]) % MOD

print(res + 1)
